title: REVO: Rollout-Efficient Off-Policy Distillation via Variance-Guided Reuse
abstract: arXiv:2609.37500v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains language models using dense token-level teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, its reliance on frequently refreshed student rollouts often incurs substantial generation cost. We introduce REVO, an off-policy distillation framework that improves rollout efficiency by reusing each student rollout for multi-step learner updates. REVO addresses prefix-level and current-token policy mismatch through stabilized prefix weighting and one-step resampling from the current student, which enables repeated updates without regenerating full trajectories. To prioritize informative token positions within reused rollouts, REVO uses the variance of the student-teacher log-probability ratio to quantify the remaining token-level learning signal and guide repeated optimization. Across multiple student-teacher scales, REVO with only 50 rollout iterations matches or exceeds OPD baselines trained for

translated_title: REVO：基于方差引导复用实现高效 Rollout 的离策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（On-policy distillation, OPD）在学生模型生成的轨迹上，利用密集的 token 级教师监督来训练语言模型。然而，它依赖于频繁刷新的学生 rollout，往往会带来高昂的生成成本。我们提出 REVO，这是一种离策略蒸馏框架，通过将每个学生 rollout 复用于多步学习器更新来提升 rollout 效率。REVO 通过稳定的前缀加权（stabilized prefix weighting）以及从当前学生模型进行的单步重采样，解决了前缀级别与当前 token 层面的策略不匹配问题，从而无需重新生成完整轨迹即可执行重复更新。为了在复用的 rollout 中优先关注信息量大的 token 位置，REVO 利用学生-教师对数概率比的方差来量化剩余的 token 级学习信号，并据此指导重复优化。在多个学生-教师模型规模下，仅使用 50 次 rollout 迭代的 REVO 即可达到甚至超过经过长时间训练的 OPD 基线……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: REVO 是一种离策略蒸馏框架，通过稳定前缀加权、单步重采样以及以学生-教师对数概率比方差为引导的复用机制，将学生 rollout 复用于多步更新，仅用 50 次 rollout 迭代即可达到甚至超过在线策略蒸馏基线的性能，大幅降低了生成成本。
en_tdlr: REVO is an off-policy distillation framework that improves rollout efficiency by reusing each student rollout for multi-step updates—via stabilized prefix weighting, one-step resampling, and variance-guided prioritization of the student-teacher log-probability ratio—matching or exceeding on-policy distillation baselines with only 50 rollout iterations.
